bull.b: Rapid growth in active buyers and orders indicates expanding platform adoption and increasing marketplace liquidity. A larger recurring customer base can improve inventory turnover, support more efficient marketing, and strengthen network effects across buyers, sellers, and brand partners over the next several quarters.

bull.t: High gross margin with improving operating leverage
bull.b: A nearly 80% gross margin, combined with positive adjusted EBITDA and year-over-year expansion, shows the platform can convert incremental revenue into improving operating profitability. Continued processing and logistics efficiency could support a more durable path toward scale economics despite ongoing investment needs.

Resale-as-a-service broadens thredUP beyond direct consumer transactions by adding branded resale programs and additional seller access. More storefronts can diversify revenue, increase supply and customer reach, and reinforce thredUP’s operational and technology position in the growing recommerce market.

bear.b: The continued GAAP loss shows that improved gross margins and adjusted EBITDA have not yet translated into sustainable bottom-line profitability. Ongoing losses can consume equity, constrain financial flexibility, and leave the company more dependent on execution improvements to reach durable earnings generation.

bear.t: Free cash flow remains thin and volatile
bear.b: Positive operating cash flow is encouraging, but minimal free cash flow leaves limited room for error after capital expenditures and makes internal funding capacity uncertain. The sharp difference from the prior annual period indicates cash conversion is not yet consistent enough to support resilient self-funded growth.

bear.t: Direct Listings have slower marketplace traction
bear.b: Slower sell-through and seller overpricing create friction in an important marketplace expansion channel. If listings remain mispriced or take longer to sell, customer engagement, transaction frequency, and inventory productivity may lag, limiting the channel’s contribution to durable growth until education and scale improve.
